summary: Modules should use type='path' in argument_spec, which expands ~ and shell variables, instead of os.path.expanduser.
questions: How do I expand ~ in a module path argument?

answer_card.title: use-argspec-type-path
answer_card.answer_md: Use `type='path'` in the argument_spec instead of `os.path.expanduser`; it ensures a string and expands `~` and shell variables.
